response.sql:
SELECT i.film_id, COUNT(*) AS copy_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share_of_all_copies
FROM inventory AS i
GROUP BY i.film_id
ORDER BY share_of_all_copies DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “For each film in the inventory” means films with at least one inventory record; the share denominator includes all inventory records.
